title: thuranthos indicus
intro: Thuranthos indicus, commonly known as Indian thuranthos, is a plant species belonging to the genus Thuranthos. It is a shrub-like plant native to the Indian subcontinent, used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits. The health benefits of Thuranthos indicus include its potential to lower cholesterol levels, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant properties, which can aid in protecting against oxidative stress and cell damage. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and glycosides, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and hepatoprotective effects.
